justification: Python distinguishes global and nonlocal bindings. A nonlocal call through a captured local must not resolve to the module-level function, while a global call resolves to the module binding.

cases.name: handler
cases.note: nonlocal handler refers to the captured local, not the module function

cases.name: handler
cases.note: global handler resolves to the module-level function
